decision_rule: Equivalence is supported in a mass-policy cell only if every Holm-adjusted TOST p < 0.05. A non-significant difference is not equivalence. Pareto and same-state summaries descriptive. Report all arms. No tuning on confirmatory seeds.

estimands.battery_pp: 100*(reference battery - arm battery)/e0 battery, within seed
estimands.local: same-state native e1 versus pk1 in native e1 runs, equal cardinality only for energy/time increments; disagreement includes unequal rounds
estimands.service: arm minus reference for completed; reference minus arm for seconds

inference.energy_sweep: two-sided paired sign-flip, Holm over 24 tests
inference.equivalence: paired t TOST, Holm over 16 tests

surrogate: Cpk = delta_t_positive/600 + (kappa*delta_t_positive + e1*delta_passenger_km)/100; signed passenger-km increment, no clipping; true energy feasibility unchanged. Cruise coefficients fixed by frozen physics; no fitting.
